[Attack] Physical attack.
Lower your opponent's anger 1. If your opponent's anger was lowered to 0, lower your opponent's MP 1 level.
DAMAGE: 4 stages.
note: no Endurance badge

name: Namekian Hybrid Defense
text:
[Defense] POWER: Stops a physical or energy attack.
Choose X cards in your discard pile and Rejuvenate them. X = your MP's level.
note: no Endurance badge

name: Namekian Overtime
text:
POWER: Rejuvenate 1. Destroy the top X cards of your opponent's Life Deck. X = the number of Dragon Balls you control. Search your Life Deck for a Styled Energy Combat card and place it into your hand.
(Banish after use.)
note: no Endurance badge

name: Namekian Right Kick
text:
(Heroes only.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
DAMAGE: 6 stages.
HIT: Search your Life Deck for a Named card and place it into your hand.
(Banish after use.)
note: no Endurance badge

name: Orange Devouring Drill
text:
(You cannot win by MPPV if you use this Drill's effect.)
[Continuous]: When you play a Drill, you may banish this card. If you do, advance a personality level.
note: landscape Drill layout; no Endurance badge

name: Orange Dismissal
text:
[Defense] Stops an energy attack.
You may shuffle a Drill you control into its owner's Life Deck. If you do, search your Life Deck for a Drill and play it.
note: no Endurance badge

name: Orange Stare Down
text:
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Banish an opponent's Setup, Drill, or Ally.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
note: stage cost printed as '2:'; no Endurance badge

name: Red Blocking Hand
text:
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
Raise your anger 2. Gain 2 stages.
note: no Endurance badge

name: Red Heel Kick
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
Raise your anger 1. You may lower your anger 2 to search your discard pile for a Styled attack not titled "Red Heel Kick" and place it into your hand.
DAMAGE: AT + 2 stages.
(Banish after use.)
note: no Endurance badge

name: Red Resourceful Block
text:
ENDURANCE 3.
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
Lower your MP 1 level. If you do, advance your MP 1 level at the end of combat.

name: Saiyan Inspection Drill
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(If this card would be discarded from your hand by one of your effects, you may banish it instead to draw a card.)
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
This attack cannot have its damage modified.
DAMAGE: 0 stages.
note: landscape Drill layout

name: Saiyan Elbow Drop
text:
[Attack] 1: Physical attack.
Remain 1.
DAMAGE: AT + 3 stages.
(Banish after use.)
(Tournament of Power 2021)
note: stage cost printed as '1:'; prints a '(Tournament of Power 2021)' event line; no Endurance badge

name: Saiyan Aerial Attack
text:
ENDURANCE 3.
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Search your Life Deck or discard pile for a Styled Drill and place it into play.
note: stage cost printed as '2:'

name: Black Swirl
text:
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Name a card. Your opponent cannot play that card for the remainder of combat.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Raise your anger 2.
(Banish after use.)
note: stage cost printed as '2:'; no Endurance badge

name: Malicious Intent
text:
ENDURANCE 4.
(If your MP has [Trait:Alien], this card is considered Named. When this card is leaving play from your effect, you may banish it to make your next attack this combat be considered to deal critical damage.)
POWER: Gain 5 stages. Choose a card in a player's discard pile and place it on top of their Life Deck. [Trait:Alien]: If you have only 1 Trait, search your opponent's Life Deck for a non-Dragon Ball card and banish it.
note: landscape Setup layout; grey card; new art for the S12 R31 text; both inline icons are the purple A badge (Alien, as zoomed on S12 BST_31)

name: Battle Pausing
text:
(Limit 2 per deck.)
POWER: Banish a card from your hand to draw the top 2 cards of your discard pile. Your opponent gains 5 stages.
(Banish after use.)
(Tournament of Power 2021)
note: grey card; prints a '(Tournament of Power 2021)' event line; no Endurance badge

name: Defiant Challenge
text:
POWER: Search your Banished Zone for a Named card and place it on top of your Life Deck. Search your Life Deck for a Named attack card and place it into your hand. Your opponent may discard a card from their hand to search their Life Deck for a Named attack card and place it into their hand.
(Banish after use.)
note: grey card; no Endurance badge; filename has a leading space before 'Defiant'

name: Halt
text:
(Limit 1 per deck.)
[Instant] POWER: [Trait:God]: If you have 2 or less Traits, use when an Event is played or a Setup Power is used. Cancel the effects of that card.
(Shuffle into your Life Deck after use.)
note: grey card; inline icon zoomed: gold G badge (God); no Endurance badge; same title as S11 BST_32

name: On The Move!
text:
(You may banish this card from your hand when an effect would cause a player to skip or pass an action to cancel that effect.)
[Defense] POWER: Stops a physical or energy attack.
If that attack was a Physical Combat or Energy Combat card, return it to your opponent's hand. Draw a card. Gain 2 stages or your opponent loses 2 stages.
(Banish after use.)
note: grey card; no Endurance badge; printed 'On The Move!' (capital T), the S11 booster prints 'On the Move!'

name: Blinding Energy Move
text:
(Limit 2 per deck. You must banish the top 2 cards of your Life Deck to play this card.)
[Attack] Energy attack.
At the beginning of the next action this combat, end combat.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
note: grey card; no Endurance badge

name: Raditz's Dirty Tactics
text:
(Limit 2 per deck.)
POWER: Name a Setup or Drill. Search your opponent's Life Deck and hand for all copies of that card and banish them.
(Banish after use.)
note: landscape Setup layout; grey card; possessive title -> Named; no Endurance badge

name: Raditz's Offensive Guard
text:
(You may banish this card from your hand to stop a physical or energy attack.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Attach to your MP. While attached, once per combat as an action you may place into play a Setup or Drill from your hand. Banish this card when you change levels.
DAMAGE: AT + 4 stages.
note: grey card; possessive title -> Named; no Endurance badge

name: Dr. Wheelo's Revival
text:
(When this card is discarded or destroyed from your Life Deck, destroy the top 3 cards of your opponent's Life Deck and banish this card.)
POWER: Your opponent cannot play Events this combat. Gain 2 stages and shuffle this card into your Life Deck.
note: landscape Setup layout; grey card; possessive title -> Named; no Endurance badge
